action_owners.AGENT_DECISION: The constrained Agent chooses a registered tool or asks/continues within the supplied scope.
action_owners.AGENT_RESPONSE: The Advisor produces a user-facing response; no model tool call is expected for this turn.
action_owners.PRODUCT_WORKFLOW: A dedicated API/UI/domain service performs the outcome outside the model tool loop.
action_owners.USER_APPROVAL: The user must approve; any persistent write is performed by the service after explicit approval.
action_owners.RUNTIME_GUARD: A deterministic safety, lifecycle, capability or recovery rule controls the outcome.

capability_contract.confirmation: Confirmation prompts and commits are separate service/API transitions, never model-callable tools.

scope_note: v4 remains preserved as the tool-allowlist-aligned historical contract. v5 adds outcome ownership and corrects destination recommendation: the current dedicated endpoint performs bounded map searches directly rather than exposing search_places to the model loop. No Agent execution or quality score is implied.
